do:
Open: Export overview → Start a new export → Non-Conformance.
Fields: Expand Non-Conformance / Rejections. Add Accession Number, Occurrence ID, Rejection Reason, Rejection Date, Date Basis, Event Date, Recorded Date, Record Source and Status, in that order.
Dates: Choose Next: Set Filters. Enter May 10, 2026 for both dates; leave optional filters unchanged.
Generate: Choose Next: Review & Submit → Generate CSV. Wait for Ready to download under Your current report, then Download CSV.
Check: Open the file in a spreadsheet or text viewer. Compare the four REPORTING-MVP-NCE rows with the expected results below.
expect:
Rows: Four distinct REPORTING-MVP-NCE occurrences have reason RPT-MVP-HAEMOLYSIS. Each has its own Occurrence ID.
Event date: One occurrence is included for its May 10 event date even though it was recorded May 12.
Recorded date: Two separate occurrences have no event date and use their May 10 recorded date; Date Basis identifies the fallback.
Earlier rejection record: One separately identified legacy rejection is included for May 10. Record Source distinguishes it from the native events.
Status: The three native events show OPEN; the legacy rejection has a blank status.
Excluded: The May 9 event and the event with no event or recorded date are absent.
